name: subtract_one_cube_from_the_other
why: The same starting part, and the second value of the enum: 1000 minus the 400 of overlap makes 600. It is the number that tells «subtract» from «intersect» -- if the two values were swapped, 400 would come out, which is a plausible volume of a plausible part.
_why_the_main_one: in subtraction the order changes the part: A minus B is not B minus A. Here the two cubes are equal, so the VOLUME is the same in both directions -- and until 25/9/2026 the case asked only that, with the main body written «C1». Entry Z-C16: the numbers of the bodies change from one run to the next (measured: the copy was C1 in one run out of three), so the main body is named by NAME and the CENTRE OF MASS is checked, which says which of the two remained: the original minus the overlap sits at (-0.667, 0, 3.333); the copy minus the original would sit at (2.667, 0, 11.667).

expect.tolerance_why: computed by hand: cube 1000 at (0,0,5) minus the overlap 8x10x5 = 400 at (1,0,7.5). The hundredth covers the rounding

expect.why: 1000 minus the 400 that the two cubes have in common
